node.statement: The objection conflates the symbol dot with uncompressed ambient multiplication. In the permitted def-ha-map, and hence in the corresponding compressed-corner data packaged by def-hcb-datum, dot denotes the typed compressed product: for A in S_{P,R} and B in S_{R,Q}, A dot B is Co_{P,Q}(AB), not the raw ambient product AB. Therefore the amplified-compression idempotence gives Co_{P,Q}(A dot B)=Co_{P,Q}^2(AB)=Co_{P,Q}(AB)=A dot B, so A dot B lies in Im(Co_{P,Q})=S_{P,Q}. Applying this to every Z_ij,X_j and using that Im(Co_{P,Q}) is a linear subspace yields V_i=sum_j Z_ij dot X_j in S_{P,Q}, hence V in M_{n,1} tensor S_{P,Q}. This argument uses only the definition of the typed compressed product and idempotence of Co; it neither asserts closure of raw ambient multiplication nor uses associativity.
